title: ShortSeq: A benchmark for foundation model evaluation on short time series
description:
ShortSeq evaluates classical, machine-learning, and foundation-model forecasters on short time series, where the sample sizes that favour large pretrained models are absent.

It provides a pip-installable package (shortseq), a rolling one-step-ahead evaluation protocol with no look-ahead, and statistical significance testing: Diebold-Mariano with Bonferroni correction for pairwise per-series comparisons, and a Friedman omnibus test with Nemenyi post-hoc for ranking multiple models across series.

The benchmark covers 368 series drawn from ten public sources, split into a short stratum (n < 200, 199 series) and a long stratum (n ≥ 200, 169 series). The two strata are analysed separately and never pooled, because they exhibit opposite-signed effects at the small-model end.

Scope of this release. ShortSeq distributes dataset loaders, evaluation code, and computed results. It does not redistribute the underlying raw data: several constituent sources are governed by licences that prohibit redistribution, and must be obtained by the user from their original providers. The repository documents how to acquire each one.
